Little things, big difference.

Auto close prunes old cards for you. Webhooks let you publish to Slack or Campfire. Your notifications stack fans open for easy access. Information bubbles up when cards are ignored. Make a board public so anyone can follow along. Stamps tell you who filed what when.

One more thing... Fizzy is open source if you'd like to run it yourself.

If you want to customize Fizzy for your own use, or just see how it looks from the inside out, you can download it and run it yourself. Have a great idea? Submit a PR to contribute and make it better. Our software license allows for flexible use with few restrictions.

Common questions.

Is Fizzy really free? Totally free?

Yes, Fizzy is entirely free. It's fully subsidized by Basecamp and HEY, our two pay products. We do limit file space usage to 1 GB, but that should be plenty of space for just about anyone.

Does Fizzy integrate with Basecamp, GitHub, Slack, or other tools?

Fizzy can use Webhooks to send events (new card created, card assigned, card completed, etc) from Fizzy into a Campfire room, Slack channel, or any other tool that can receive data via Webhooks. In addition, Fizzy has an API for custom integrations.

Can we import data from other services into Fizzy?

We don't currently offer importing data from other services (like Basecamp, Trello, GitHub Issues, Jira, etc) into Fizzy. We'd like to offer this down the road, but it's not part of the current release.

Can we really install Fizzy on our own servers?

Yes, Fizzy is Open Source and you can download the code from GitHub and run the product on your own server (or another hosted server you pay for). Be sure to review the Fizzy software license if you'll be running or modifying it for your own use.

Any AI features?

We didn't add artificial intelligence, we just removed all the stupid from typical kanban implementations. No bloat, lots of speed, plenty of power, and a fun UI. Try it.
